typography.scaling: Fluid scale with tight tracking on H1/H2

layouts.sidebar: collapsible compact by default, 5 main sections: Investigation Officer, Police Department, Future Department 1, Future Department 2, Future Department 3
layouts.main_content: flexible responsive container with generous spacing and data-testid attributes

accessibility.attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a secure Legal & Investigation Document Processing and Management Web Application with login, collapsible 5-section sidebar (Investigation Officer, Police Department, Future Department 1, Future Department 2, Future Department 3), case-centric document management (Rahul Sharma, CASE-2026-00125), SHA-256 tamper detection and verification, version control, audit trail page, and robust data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure black or grey without tinting
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs
Never use transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays without blur
Ensure all state changes have explicit hover and focus text/bg colors
